agent_instructions.role: You are a Senior Android Engineer. Build FocusForge: A deep-work timer app where every completed focused work block generates building materials to construct, decorate, and expand a small isometric digital village.
code_standards: Jetpack Compose for all UI with smooth animations.
Room database for all persistent data storage.
Hilt for dependency injection across all layers.
WorkManager for background tasks and notifications.
Google Play Billing 6.x for subscription management.
Material Design 3 with custom gamification/wellness theming.

architecture.data_layer: Repository pattern with Room DAO and optional API calls
architecture.domain_layer: Use cases for business logic encapsulation

execution_steps.step_1: Setup project structure with Hilt, Room, Navigation, DataStore.

execution_steps.step_2: Define domain models and Room entities for app-specific data.

execution_steps.step_3: Build core feature screens with Compose and ViewModel state management.

execution_steps.step_4: Implement gamification/wellness mechanics specific to this app concept.

execution_steps.step_5: Add notification system with WorkManager for daily engagement.

execution_steps.step_6: Build statistics/progress screens with Compose Canvas charts.

execution_steps.step_7: Integrate Google Play Billing for premium subscription tier.

execution_steps.step_8: Polish animations, add onboarding flow, and prepare Play Store assets.
